description: This PHP class 'EmergencyContact' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField\EmergencyContact\Dto' extends 'NormalizableDTO' and encapsulates the emergency contact details of an employee. It includes methods for converting data to an array format and defines a mapping of object fields to getter methods, related to an employee's emergency contact information.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: Represents the emergency contact information for an employee, providing methods to serialize data and map fields to getter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmergencyContact instance with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the emergency contact data of the employee to an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods for emergency contact attributes.
